items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: much to my surprise upon it was Eddie Miller that had recorded that

ctx.x: What about Fazzola? Did you know him?

Oh yes, everybody's in Fazzola. Just everybody. Fazzola came on the scene with the Bob Crosby band shortly after Goodman had generated all this interest in clarinet, and it was just a solid rave all the way, Fazzola's clarinet playing. And there again you have an example, because prior to that time, well, Eddie Miller played some clarinet, made one notable recording instead of fashion of clarinet, and then wasn't it Matty Matlock that played clarinet with that band too? Yeah. I remember when Fazzola came in, he…
What was the Miller record? Do you remember? It might sometime, Dick.
